messages:
kate_sales: Quick heads up — RiverBank needs a compact POC assurance bundle to unblock procurement: SOC2 excerpts (encryption + access control), pen-test attestation (they prefer vendor-signed if possible), a short OSS dependency list, and a Dedicated+VPC pricing delta note. They want it by EOD Friday.
omar_se: I can pull SOC2 excerpts and a network sketch. We typically provide an unsigned pen-test template; legal signs vendor letters (3 business days). Do they need an active external scan?
trina_security: For dependency list I'll include top infra libs and our patching/vuln-scan cadence. Note: external scans require a 72h window and approved IP ranges. If they want vendor-signed attestation we need legal ok or an external attestor (+7 days).
ops_lee: Pricing delta depends on reserved vGPU commitments and whether they want single-tenant vs shared. If they want UK residency with tenant isolation, add ~1.6x to baseline—will produce a short table with assumptions once we confirm sustained RPS.
kate_sales: They reported ~30 rps sustained, avg 1.2k tokens, bursts to ~160 rps. Preferred UK residency but can accept eu-west if delta >20%.
omar_se: OK I'll assemble: SOC2 excerpt PDF, pen-test template (marked sample), network diagram, KMS options note, and a short README explaining signatory flow.
trina_security: I'll add dependency matrix + scan rules.
ops_lee: I'll post a quick pricing delta table within an hour.
kate_sales: Action items: Omar attach bundle by Thu EOD, Trina add dependency matrix & signatory text, Lee post pricing delta. I'll check with RiverBank about active scans. :thumbsup:
